The '''Ord Antalaha system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located along the [[Shwuy Exchange/Legends|Shwuy Exchange]]<ref name="PP" /> in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Antalaha]].
